AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

2. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. newton (N)
   C. watt (W)
   D. pascal (Pa)

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animal Health: Disease Control? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Animal Health: Disease Control.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animal Health: Disease Control.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animal Health: Disease Control.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animal Health: Disease Control.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Powered Agricultural Implements? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Powered Agricultural Implements.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Powered Agricultural Implements.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Powered Agricultural Implements.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Powered Agricultural Implements.

5. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Overgrazing continuously

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Forage Crops? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Forage Crops.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Forage Crops.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Forage Crops.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Forage Crops.

7. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

8. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Protection: Disease control? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Protection: Disease control.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Protection: Disease control.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Protection: Disease control.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Protection: Disease control.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Livestock Nutrition? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Livestock Nutrition.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Livestock Nutrition.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Livestock Nutrition.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Livestock Nutrition.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Agricultural Biotechnology? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Agricultural Biotechnology.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agricultural Biotechnology.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Agricultural Biotechnology.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Agricultural Biotechnology.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Agri- business Accounts? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Agri- business Accounts.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agri- business Accounts.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Agri- business Accounts.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Agri- business Accounts.

13. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only carbon dioxide

14. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Producers
   D. Tertiary consumers

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ornamental Cropping? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Ornamental Cropping.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ornamental Cropping.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ornamental Cropping.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Ornamental Cropping.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animal Breeding? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animal Breeding.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animal Breeding.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animal Breeding.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Animal Breeding.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Non- conventional Livestock and Companion Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Urban and peri-urban Agriculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Powered Agricultural Implements and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Agricultural Biotechnology and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Agri- business Accounts and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Business and Career Opportunities in Agriculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
